Setup.Name: Usage of Scopes
Setup.Description: Uses a custom instrumentation scope on a metric.
Setup.Manifest:
OtelScopes:
  - Name: "MyApplicationTest"
    Version: "17.1.2"
    ApplyDefaultAttributes: false
    Attributes:
      - Key: "Environment"
        Value: "Test"
  - Name: "MyApplicationProd"
    Version: "17.1.2"
    ApplyDefaultAttributes: true
    Attributes:
      - Key: "Environment"
        Value: "Prod"

Processors:
  - Name: "Processor Temperature"
    Description: "Connects a metric to a scope. Remove the OtelScope property to get the default (=first) scope."
    Mqtt: 
      Subscriptions:
        - Topic: "sensor/+/raw"
    Otel:
      Metrics:
        - Name: "Processor.Temperature"
          OtelScope: "MyApplicationTest"
          Instrument: Gauge
          Value: "PAYLOAD()"
